decision: What has run is observed by this observatory alone: the lab asks it to observe what has run every quarter hour, and its voice says what newly comes into view here - urgently where the lens of signs says so. A part observed writes only its own tables. ocoeco is taken from its release, checked against its sums, in seconds where building it took minutes.
why: Sign runs-are-observed-twice (open-commons-observatory/ocoeco): the lab observed what had run on its own every quarter hour, beside this observatory, because this observatory observed only every six hours and on landings - too seldom to hear in time that something broke. Looked at first: the observation that is the place's own is this one - its record keeps what it saw, and its page is made from it; the lab's was there for timing only. Tried before: observing a part rewrote what the whole had found (decision 2026-11-14-a-part-observed-speaks-for-itself in ocoeco).
rejected: The lab observing and pushing what it saw here (one more writer of this record); this observatory observing every quarter hour on its own schedule (GitHub's schedule is seldom kept that often); keeping both and quieting one voice by a rule.
